title: Zero Means None
short: 0 is the number for none at all.
trouble: Children do not think of 0 as a number.

blocks.html: What if there is nothing at all? That number is zero, and we write it 0. An empty plate has 0 cookies.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: How many cookies are on the plate? None: zero.

blocks.html: Zero means none at all. We write it 0.

blocks.title: All gone
blocks.q: Ana had 2 cookies and ate them both. How many now?

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Use zero in everyday talk: “There are zero socks in the basket now!” Count down to zero with a rocket blast-off: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0! Short and happy beats long. Five minutes is a good lesson.

items: Try it at home: Count down to 0 before a race.
Eat crackers one by one until there are 0.
Ask: how many elephants are in the kitchen?
